seo.title: Cookies and storage: analytics only with consent | DOM VIRUS
seo.description: DOM VIRUS sets analytics cookies only if you accept. Here is every cookie and every setting the games save in your browser, and how to clear them.

sections.heading: Cookies and storage
sections.headingAccent: No cookies until you say yes.
sections.body: DOM VIRUS sets no cookies unless you accept analytics. The games remember a few settings in your browser's local storage, and those never leave your device. This page lists every cookie and key, what it holds and how to clear it. Last updated 2026-10-31.

sections.heading: Cookies
body: The games never set cookies. The site sets analytics cookies only after you choose Accept in the cookie banner. Reject is one click, just like Accept, and we remember either answer.
Change your mind any time: open Cookie settings at the foot of any page. Cloudflare Web Analytics, when switched on, is cookieless.

sections.heading: Where the saved settings live
body: Browsers keep local storage per site address. Today the DOM VIRUS hub, the DOM Battlefield site and the Fizlet site share one address, coded-dot-design.github.io.
That is why one theme choice follows you between them. Clearing that address's data clears all three.
When another site runs one of the games, the game saves its keys under that site's address instead.

sections.heading: Analytics cookies: only after you accept

items.title: _ga
items.body: Google Analytics 4 (Google). Tells visits apart so we can count usage. Expires after 2 years.

items.title: _ga_<id>
items.body: Google Analytics 4 (Google). Keeps the state of your current visit. Expires after 2 years.

items.title: ph_<project key>_posthog
items.body: PostHog. An anonymous id and visit state for usage and gameplay events, in a cookie and in local storage. Expires after 1 year.

items.title: dom-virus:consent
items.body: Your cookie choice (analytics yes or no) and when you made it, so the banner does not ask again.

items.title: dom-virus:theme
items.body: Your colour theme: system, dark or light. Shared by the hub, Battlefield and Fizlet sites.

items.title: dom-virus:sherman-bytes:sound
items.body: Sound on or off in Sherman Bytes.

items.title: dom-virus:byte-runner:sound
items.body: Sound on or off in Byte Runner.

items.title: dom-virus:null-invaders:sound
items.body: Sound on or off in Null Invaders.

items.title: dom-virus:swarm
items.body: Your best Swarm Protocol score on the hub.

items.title: dom-virus:swarm:sound
items.body: Sound on or off in Swarm Protocol on the hub.

items.title: dom-virus:battlefield:sound
items.body: Sound on or off in DOM Battlefield.

items.title: dom-battlefield:setup
items.body: Your last DOM Battlefield setup: mission, side, density, map seed, formation and squad roles. A rematch starts where you left off.

items.title: dom-battlefield:intro
items.body: Marks the DOM Battlefield intro card as seen, so it shows only once on phones and tablets.

items.title: dom-battlefield:tips
items.body: Remembers that you switched DOM Battlefield tips off.

items.title: dom-battlefield:battle-cards
items.body: Whether the DOM Battlefield plan and orders cards are folded or pinned.

items.title: dom-battlefield:roster
items.body: The layout of the DOM Battlefield platoon card in full screen: grid, column or row.

items.title: dom-battlefield:dock
items.body: Whether the DOM Battlefield full-screen cards show icons only or labels.

items.title: blitz:mode
items.body: The Battlefield Blitz mode you picked last: solo, platoon or practice.

items.title: blitz:pad
items.body: Where you dragged the Battlefield Blitz touch pad.

sections.heading: Session storage: gone when the tab closes

items.title: dom-virus:doors
items.body: Set for a moment when you launch DOM Battlefield from the hub, so the board opens behind the same shut doors. Removed as soon as the board loads.

sections.heading: How to clear them
body: Clear this site's data in your browser settings to remove every cookie and key at once. To keep analytics off afterwards, choose Reject when the banner asks again. Most browsers list it under privacy or site settings, by site address.
Clearing does no harm. The theme goes back to its default, sound comes back on and DOM Battlefield starts from a fresh setup.
Developers can also open the browser's developer tools, find Local Storage under Application or Storage, and delete single keys.

sections.heading: What we never use
body: No advertising, remarketing or social media cookies, and no ad pixels. If that ever changes, this page and the privacy policy change first, with a new date, and nothing new runs until you agree.
